subject: Re: Kickoff: pretraining for irregular time series
body: Packaging decision from yesterday's review: ship it. The recipe goes out as an internal package (pretraining configs + mask banks + STraTS-compatible encoder), and the benchmark suite launches with PhysioNet-2012, MIMIC-III and H&M — the three-dataset evidence was convincing, with pretraining winning on all three and the low-label gains (+2.5 AUROC on PhysioNet at 10% labels) doing the persuading. Saoirse's leaderboard goes live to the two pilot teams June 8 with submission auth on; eICU gets added whenever the approval clears, as a fast-follow rather than a blocker. Deferred: the retail-specific augmentation ideas — interesting, but Q3 material, and they would have blown the window. Kaia writes the model card and access-requirements page (the DUA constraints need to be impossible to miss). Clean landing, three days early. — Dmitri
